behavior: Extend existing tested runner without changing historical weighting/alignment defaults. Pin standard HMMER3.4 binaries and all frozen source/runtime/canonical inputs. Off must reproduce canonical graph/candidate/native controls and scores. Every active arm must have the identical canonical nomination digest. HMMER measurement-only must reproduce all off graph stage bytes, candidate/constraints, native products/rooted species tree and scores; failed measurement control blocks active HMMER without suppressing the separate native decision-only result. Both active reselects retain their independent original point gates; incomplete applicability cannot advance and remains an explicit diagnostic/fallback requirement.
evidence_readback: New validator reads actual fresh selection/measurement files, complete original profile-source partition, query ownership, complete competitor/member/target sets, boundary priority/digest/budgets, original source thresholds/anchors, pinned tool binaries, exact build/search controls and raw HMMER sequence/domain tables. Recomputes decisions and applied/counterfactual counts with shared validated package rules. This is separate evidence readback, not an independent algorithm implementation or a re-execution of original profile candidate generation.
native_pairs: New structured confidence-table reader reports added/lost/retained native pairs, source/candidate confidence populations, retained class transitions and lost versus downgraded baseline high pairs. These are descriptive turnover counts, never reference F1. Files are pinned and ownership/duplicates checked.

tests.scope: Fourteen overlapping pilot/selector/readback/native-pair/profile/replay/local/HMMER modules. Includes22 new pilot/validator cases and7 pair-turnover cases; do not sum overlapping receipt counts as independent coverage.

actual_native_fixture: Complete16-gene/four-species source search establishes its own canonical checkpoint/control, then all four arms execute actual graph replay, satellite candidate construction and ordinary inferred-species-tree/reconciliation writers. HMMER measurement-only matches exact canonical native products/species tree and all graph/candidate controls. Benchmark scoring is deliberately mocked for this integration fixture, and activity may be absent; separate actual profile expansion fixtures require nonempty HMMER measurements/decisions. This is not biological accuracy or generalization evidence.
test_history: First complete native-runner fixture passed22 tests. Adding pair-turnover reporting exposed a new column-order parsing bug plus a mocked case missing baseline_output; a broad run retained476 passes/eight failures. Corrected the structured field access and fixture path, then484 passed. No frozen biological run was changed or interpreted from those failures.
remaining: Commit/push and freeze this runner, prepare its immutable complete OrthoBench plan and queue behind current sequential scientific jobs. Independently admit all actual results, paired-family uncertainty and HMMER-versus-native-policy effects. Complete any prespecified applicability fallback and unchanged full-vector extension for advancing arms only. Finish production opt-in interface if warranted.
preservation: Unrelated tests/samples status/binary-diff fingerprints and all three original CPU-library hashes unchanged.
